paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Zarnuki and R. Shimon ben Yehotzadak went to intercalate years in Asya. Resh Lakish met them and went with them. Before R. Yochanan, Resh Lakish called him a cattle herder and [called them] a conspiracy of evildoers: Sanhedrin 26a.
